d: A small, round avian species with vivid electric-yellow plumage and a small tufted crest. Beady, circular black eyes. A plump, spherical body with two small wings and three-toed yellow claws. Wears a miniature, ornate Aztec-style headdress of turquoise and gold. Features a short, stubby yellow tail and a small, pointed yellow beak. BODY COLOR: electric yellow.
